Q: Is this a proper way to implement "chance" in randomness? A:

Yes, except you should not do the +1. 0 through 19, inclusive, is 20, and 0 through 99, inclusive, is 100.

Q: Why tomcat wont start with Failed to start apache tomcat web server tomcat.service: Control process exited, code=exited status=203 A:

In my case seems was caused by database unavailability. It went down due to disk space issue and application was unable to access the JPA Repos.

I've noticed it when tried to access the database manually, then after solving the issue and making sure db is up, the application was able to start just fine.

Q: ddev saying "ngrok not found in path, please install it" when trying to share my wordpress project A:

I'd suggest you to use taupi instead of ngrok.

2 commands :

curl -fsSL https://taupi.dev/install.sh | bash

taupi tunnel 3000

Documentation : https://taupi.dev/docs

Q: Git keeps prompting me for a password A:

I'm sorry but all answers are a long way around to a simple solution. You want to update your netrc file

nano ~/.netrc

machine github.com login username password ghp_token
